title: Scania R620 XT Series Custom Built Wild Bar design Bullbar #28
description: Scania XT Series Custom Built Powder Coated Wild Bar design Bullbar. This Non-Fups bullbar mounts onto the original bumper bar to allow for the original extra high load tow pin fitted ex Scania factory to be used. Pivot bolts are incorporated into the original bumper bar mounts allowing the bar to be easily dropped for cab tilt. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium box uprights and 76mm high tensile 6mm wall tube have been used for maximum strength. Driving light & light bar mounts are fitted to the customer requirements. The bar can be supplied powder coated (to a range of colours) or polished.
